terms.definitionEn: A new render pass that recalculates a component's output from its current props and state.
terms.definitionAr: مرحلة render جديدة بتحسب ناتج component من props وstate الحاليين.

terms.definitionEn: A higher-order component that can skip rendering a function component when its props are unchanged by shallow comparison.
terms.definitionAr: واجهة بتغلف function component وممكن تمنع render لما props ما تتغيرش بالمقارنة السطحية.
terms.example:
const Row = React.memo(function Row({ name }) { return

terms.definitionEn: A Hook that caches a calculated value between renders while its dependencies remain unchanged.
terms.definitionAr: Hook بيخزن قيمة محسوبة بين مرات render طول ما dependencies ما اتغيرتش.

terms.definitionEn: A Hook that caches a function definition between renders while its dependencies remain unchanged.
terms.definitionAr: Hook بيخزن تعريف function بين مرات render طول ما dependencies ما اتغيرتش.

terms.definitionEn: The list of reactive values that determine when a Hook's cached value or Effect must be recalculated or rerun.
terms.definitionAr: قائمة القيم المتغيرة اللي بتحدد إمتى قيمة Hook تتعاد أو Effect يتنفذ تاني.

terms.definitionEn: A comparison that checks top-level values rather than recursively comparing nested object contents.
terms.definitionAr: مقارنة بتفحص القيم على المستوى الأول من غير ما تدخل تقارن محتوى الـ objects المتداخلة.

terms.definitionEn: An object or function identity that remains the same across renders when its dependencies have not changed.
terms.definitionAr: مرجع object أو function بيفضل ثابت بين مرات render لو dependencies ما اتغيرتش.

terms.definitionEn: React's process for comparing rendered element trees and determining the updates needed for the UI.
terms.definitionAr: عملية React لمقارنة أشجار العناصر وتحديد التحديثات المطلوبة للواجهة.

terms.definitionEn: A special value that helps React match sibling elements across renders; it is not passed as an ordinary prop.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة خاصة بتساعد React تميّز العناصر المتجاورة بين مرات render، ومش بتتبعت كـ prop عادي.

terms.definitionEn: An API that defers loading a component's code until it is rendered, typically using a dynamic import.
terms.definitionAr: واجهة بتأخر تحميل كود component لحد ما يتعرض، غالبًا باستخدام dynamic import.

terms.definitionEn: A component that displays fallback UI while a supported child is waiting to become ready.
terms.definitionAr: component بتعرض fallback مؤقت لحد ما ابن مدعوم يبقى جاهز.

terms.definitionEn: The reference identity of a prop value, which can affect shallow memoization when objects or functions are recreated.
terms.definitionAr: هوية المرجع لقيمة prop، وممكن تأثر على المقارنة السطحية لما object أو function يتعملوا من جديد.

questions.question: What normally happens when Parent renders again?
options: Child is rendered as part of the parent update unless an applicable optimization skips it
Child is never rendered again because its name prop is a string and the parent did not change it
React reloads the Child module from the network on every parent render before creating its element
Child updates only when it calls a state setter itself, regardless of parent renders or changed props
questions.explanation: A parent render normally renders its child components too, unless an optimization such as memoization can skip work.
questions.explanationAr: عادةً render الأب بيخلّي الأبناء يعملوا render كمان، إلا لو optimization زي memoization منعت الشغل.

questions.question: When does React reuse the cached calculation?
options: Only when the component has rendered exactly once
When the items dependency is unchanged between renders
Whenever calculate returns the same number for different inputs
Only after the component has been removed and mounted again
questions.explanation: useMemo reuses its cached value when its dependencies compare equal between renders.
questions.explanationAr: useMemo بتعيد استخدام القيمة المخزنة لما dependencies تفضل متساوية بين مرات render.

questions.question: What is being cached by useCallback?
options: The result returned by save(documentId) after executing the callback during the initial render
The document data fetched from the server and stored for later use by this component
The function definition, while documentId stays unchanged
Every render of the component that owns the callback, including updates from unrelated parents
questions.explanation: useCallback caches the function identity until a listed dependency changes.
questions.explanationAr: useCallback بتخزن هوية الـ function لحد ما dependency مذكورة تتغير.

questions.code: const List = React.memo(function List({ items }) { return <Items items={items} />; });
questions.question: What can cause List to render again despite React.memo?
options: A parent renders but passes exactly the same props
The component returns a stable JSX element on each call
Its module was already imported before the page loaded
A prop such as items receives a new array reference
questions.explanation: React.memo compares props shallowly, so a newly created array reference counts as a changed prop.
questions.explanationAr: React.memo بتقارن props مقارنة سطحية، فالـ array الجديدة بمرجع مختلف تعتبر prop متغيرة.

questions.question: Why may this object prop defeat a shallow memo comparison on each parent render?
options: A new object reference is created each time this declaration runs
React.memo recursively compares every nested object property to determine if the contents changed
Objects are converted into strings before being passed as props to memoized function components
The settings prop is ignored unless it is stored with useState and updated by a setter
questions.explanation: A new object literal has a new reference, so shallow equality treats the prop as changed.
questions.explanationAr: كل object literal جديدة ليها reference جديد، فالمقارنة السطحية بتعتبر prop اتغيرت.

questions.code: const value = useMemo(() => expensive(a, b), [a, b]);
questions.question: What must the dependency list include?
options: Every variable declared anywhere in the component, whether the calculation reads it or not
The reactive values read by the calculation that can change
Only the result returned by expensive after the callback has executed once
The component name and the current render number so the cache can be identified
questions.explanation: Dependencies include reactive values used by the calculation so the cached value updates when they change.
questions.explanationAr: الـ dependencies بتشمل القيم المتغيرة اللي الحساب بيستخدمها علشان القيمة تتحدث لما تتغير.

questions.question: Why is a stable item ID usually a better key than the array index?
options: An ID lets React skip rendering every Row unconditionally, even when its props or state change
An index is not allowed as a key in any React list, including static lists that never change
Stable IDs preserve item identity when list entries are inserted or reordered
Keys are passed to Row as its item.id prop automatically whenever the child component renders
questions.explanation: Stable keys help React match items across insertions, removals, and reordering; key is not passed as a normal prop.
questions.explanationAr: الـ keys الثابتة بتساعد React تتابع العناصر مع الإضافة والحذف والترتيب، ومش بتتبعت كـ prop عادي.

questions.question: What does Suspense provide in this example?
options: A permanent error message if the imported module is unavailable
A fallback UI while the lazy component's code is loading
A cache that prevents Chart from ever being rendered twice
A server request that downloads chart data before rendering
questions.explanation: Suspense displays its fallback while React waits for the lazy-loaded component code.
questions.explanationAr: Suspense بتعرض fallback لحد ما React يستنى كود الـ component اللي بيتحمّل lazy.

questions.question: How should useMemo generally be treated?
options: As a performance optimization rather than a guarantee needed for correctness
As a replacement for state whenever a value changes over time, including values updated by user actions
As a way to make compute run only once for the lifetime of the application across all mounted components
As a guarantee that React will preserve the cached value forever, even after the component is removed
questions.explanation: Memoization can avoid recalculation, but correctness should not depend on React retaining the cache forever.
questions.explanationAr: memoization ممكن توفر إعادة الحساب، بس صحة البرنامج ما تعتمدش على بقاء الـ cache للأبد.

options: true
false
null
undefined

questions.explanationAr: كل object literal بتعمل object بمرجع مختلف.

questions.prompt: Cache this calculation while items is unchanged.
questions.explanation: useMemo caches a calculated value according to its dependencies.
questions.explanationAr: useMemo بتخزن قيمة محسوبة حسب dependencies.

questions.explanation: useCallback preserves a callback identity while its dependencies stay unchanged.
questions.explanationAr: useCallback بتحافظ على هوية callback طول ما dependencies ثابتة.

questions.explanation: The key prop helps React match sibling elements between renders.

questions.explanation: Suspense displays fallback content while a supported child is waiting.

questions.explanation: Object.is compares whether the two values are the same value, including object identity.
questions.explanationAr: Object.is بتقارن إذا كانت القيمتين نفس القيمة، وده بيشمل هوية الـ object.

questions.prompt: Read this row's key from the data so React can match list items.
questions.explanation: A stable identifier is commonly used as the list key.
questions.explanationAr: غالبًا بنستخدم معرّف ثابت كـ key للعنصر في القائمة.

questions.question: What events can cause a React component to render again, and how should performance be investigated?
keyPoints: State or context updates can render a component
A parent render normally reaches children
Measure the actual bottleneck before optimizing
Memoization is not required for correctness
questions.modelAnswer: A component can render again when its state or consumed context changes, and a parent render normally renders its children. First measure where the expensive work occurs rather than adding memoization everywhere. Optimize only when the measured work matters, and keep the result correct without relying on a cache.
questions.explanation: Understanding render triggers and measuring first avoids unnecessary complexity.
questions.explanationAr: فهم أسباب render والقياس الأول بيمنع تعقيد من غير داعي.

questions.question: How do React.memo, useMemo, and useCallback differ?
keyPoints: React.memo wraps a component and compares its props
All require correct dependency or prop behavior
questions.modelAnswer: React.memo can skip rendering a component when its props are unchanged under its comparison. useMemo caches the result of a calculation, while useCallback caches a function identity. These are performance tools, so dependencies must be correct and application behavior should not rely on the caches being permanent.
questions.explanation: The APIs memoize different things: component rendering, a value, or a callback.
questions.explanationAr: كل API بتخزن حاجة مختلفة: render component أو قيمة أو callback.

questions.question: Why can newly created object and function props reduce the benefit of memoization?
keyPoints: New literals and inline functions have new identities
Memoize only when there is a measured need
Dependencies must still reflect captured values
questions.modelAnswer: A new object literal or inline function usually has a different reference on each render. A shallow comparison can therefore treat the prop as changed even when its contents look equivalent. useMemo or useCallback may help preserve identity when that avoids meaningful work, but they should be applied based on measured needs and correct dependencies.
questions.explanation: Reference identity, not deep content equality, drives the default shallow prop comparison.
questions.explanationAr: هوية المرجع، مش مقارنة المحتوى العميقة، هي اللي بتحكم المقارنة السطحية الافتراضية.

questions.question: How do stable keys and lazy loading support performance and correct UI updates?
keyPoints: Keys let React match siblings across list changes
Keys should be stable and unique among siblings
Lazy loading defers module code until needed
questions.modelAnswer: Stable keys help React match list items through insertion, removal, or reordering so state and updates follow the intended item. Lazy loading can defer a component module until it is needed, and Suspense can show fallback UI while it loads. Neither technique replaces choosing sensible component boundaries or measuring performance.
questions.explanation: Keys support reconciliation, while lazy loading changes when code is fetched.
questions.explanationAr: الـ keys بتساعد reconciliation، والتحميل الكسول بيغيّر توقيت تحميل الكود.
